claims.hypothesis: M87 has only very weak recent star formation despite its cool core and multiphase gas
claims.experiment: Compare Group 2 UV sources to SLUG simulations and forward-model cluster ages and masses
claims.result: time-averaged SFR 1.8e-5 Msun/yr and about 1000 Msun formed, peaking about 125 Myr ago
claims.finding: star formation in M87 is extremely low, far below the X-ray cooling rate

evidence.quote: The time-averaged SFR in M87 is extremely low, $1.8^{+1.7}_{-0.4} \times 10^{-5}$ M$_\odot$ yr$^{-1}$, over four orders of magnitude below the X-ray cooling rate.

claims.hypothesis: The excess blue sources are a UV-upturn population rather than young stellar sources
claims.experiment: Compare Group 2 F275W-F606W colours with UV-upturn and blue horizontal branch models
claims.result: model colours are far redder than Group 2 colours
claims.finding: the blue sources are young stellar sources, not UV-upturn stars

evidence.quote: we ruled out their origin as a UV-upturn population and identified them as YSS.

evidence.loc: Excitation mechanisms of the filaments in the F275W Band

referee_caveats_inferred: The ALMA measurement is a single flux density from an archive pipeline image with no stated beam, band or rms, so the 214 GHz point and the 0.96 radio index depend on unreported details
ALMA and VLA apertures were not background-subtracted and the VLA/ALMA beams likely differ from the aperture, so the radio index may be biased by lobe emission and resolution mismatch
The Bhattacharyya match and the forward-model posterior depend on simulated cluster libraries and the Group 2 selection and background correction, which are not independently validated
